label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 121

obligations.text:
Data-sharing code
(1)
The Commission must prepare a code of practice which contains—
(a)
practical guidance in relation to the sharing of personal data in accordance with the requirements of the data protection legislation, and
(b)
such other guidance as the Commission considers appropriate to promote good practice in the sharing of personal data.

(3)
Before preparing a code or amendments under this section, the Commission must consult the Secretary of State and such of the following as the Commission considers appropriate—
(a)
trade associations;
